game_title: Stack Of Plates – Relic Vault Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: In Relic Vault, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the moon altar using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the moon altar is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Relic Vault'. region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Relic Vault.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 15.
